content: [{"id":"njw-setup-head","type":"header","data":{"text":"Set it up","col":12}},{"id":"njw-setup-steps","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Open Njiwa Settings and paste the API key from your Njiwa console. Save, then press Test connection: it reads the saved key and lists the WhatsApp numbers this account really has. Then press Send test message, give it your own number, and read what comes back. That is the whole setup.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-setup-testkey","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Start with a key beginning sk_test_. Every message is checked and stored, and nothing reaches a real phone until you swap it for a key beginning sk_live_.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-settings","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa Settings","col":3}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-console","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa console","col":3}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-docs","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa docs","col":3}},{"id":"njw-spacer","type":"spacer","data":{"col":12}},{"id":"njw-send-head","type":"header","data":{"text":"Sending from your own code","col":12}},{"id":"njw-send-body","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"This app adds no document events, no scheduled jobs and no buttons to your forms. Deciding when a customer gets a message belongs in your own code, where you can read it later and change it without waiting for us. It is one import and one call, from njiwa_frappe.api import send, and it belongs in a background job whenever somebody is waiting for a screen.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-links","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The console at console.upeo.ai is where keys are made, numbers are linked, and every message already sent can be read back with its status and its failure reason. The docs at docs.njiwa.upeo.ai cover what a message can carry and give every error code a page of its own.","col":12}}]
